description: A curated literary Chinese language pack for ECHO. It covers the current interface and Workshop authoring copy; missing keys fall back to built-in Simplified Chinese. Data-only JSON, no scripts, network access or binaries.
changeNote: Version 1.4.0: added complete coverage for split Simplified Chinese locale modules, rewrote common Workshop and community copy, and removed blunt single-character substitutions that caused broken pseudo-classical Chinese.
